release.name: v7.0.4
release.body:
## [7.0.4](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Tenants/compare/v7.0.3...v7.0.4) (2026-11-05)


### Bug Fixes

* **build:** qualify the public EventStore 4.1.0 cohort ([42c9d23](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Tenants/commit/42c9d23adfb53a353b10c7598930f03a84426745))

commit.message: docs: clarify the current SDK selection

files.patch:
@@ -2,4 +2,4 @@
 
 Tenants administration and cross-tenant catalog operations now use declared platform scopes. The public `system` tenant is reserved; existing `system` stream identities remain an internal storage detail behind the authenticated EventStore workload route.
 
-The 7.0.0 package cohort requires EventStore 4.0.4 and McpCli.Abstractions 2.0.0. The 7.0.3 update selects qualified public EventStore 4.1.0 by default; explicit 4.0.4 package builds remain available for compatibility. Upgrade those producers first, then upgrade all Tenants packages together. Update callers that supplied `system` as a public tenant or expected a per-call tenant for a platform-scoped operation. The catalog includes the global administrator audit query as a separate platform operation.
+The 7.0.0 package cohort requires EventStore 4.0.4 and McpCli.Abstractions 2.0.0. Current package builds select qualified public EventStore 4.1.0 by default; explicit 4.0.4 package builds remain available for compatibility. Upgrade those producers first, then upgrade all Tenants packages together. Update callers that supplied `system` as a public tenant or expected a per-call tenant for a platform-scoped operation. The catalog includes the global administrator audit query as a separate platform operation.
